title: AgentCore temporal policies: your agent's guardrails have amnesia
caption:
Your agent's guardrails have amnesia 🧠

A normal Cedar policy is stateless. It only sees the current request, so it can't say "only disburse a payment after this claim was approved".

AgentCore temporal policies can. Their decisions depend on what happened earlier in the session.

What to know before you use them:
→ Written in Dogwood, which supports all existing Cedar policies
→ formerly within, since within, count and sum
→ Limits: 24h window, 3 operators per policy, 20 temporal policies per engine
→ The prior action needs its own plain permit, or the rule never matches
→ Roll out in LOG_ONLY first, then ENFORCE
→ You must send the session-ID header yourself
→ A count limit is not a security control: a new session resets it

Save this before you add approval rules to an agent 🔖
Follow @shivanshu_builds for practical agent engineering on AWS, one carousel a day.

Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/policy-temporal.html

slides.headline: Your agent's guardrails ==have amnesia.==
slides.sub: Stateless policies see one request. Temporal policies see the session.

slides.title: A rule that needs memory
paragraphs: Standard Cedar policies "are stateless and consider only the current request".
So "disburse only after this claim was approved" can't be expressed. Temporal policies' decisions **depend on the history of the agent's actions within a session**.

slides.title: Approve first, then disburse
slides.foot: Condensed from the AWS authoring docs. Ellipses mark shortened names.

slides.title: The prior action needs a ==plain permit==

cards.title: No permit for approve_claim
cards.text: It is denied and recorded as an error, not a response.

cards.title: Rule never matches
cards.text: The condition looks for a response event, so disburse stays denied.
cards.fix: Add a separate plain permit for approve_claim.

items.title: formerly within
items.text: a matching event happened earlier in the window

items.title: since within
items.text: a condition has held since an anchor event

items.title: count
items.text: matching events, including the current request

items.title: sum
items.text: over integer fields such as amountCents

items.title: 24 hours
items.text: maximum time window per temporal condition

items.title: Same account + Region

cards.title: No session ID, no request
cards.text: Send x-amzn-bedrock-agentcore-policy-session-id yourself. The Gateway won't generate one.

cards.title: Count is not security
cards.text: The caller picks the session, so a new session resets the count.

cards.title: Edit a policy, get a 409
cards.text: Changing a temporal policy invalidates open sessions.
